title: Reference Extensions correctly after shared-framework inclusion
goal: Remove framework-redundant Extensions package references when targeting .NET 11; retain older-target and implementation dependencies and verify actual restore and deployment assets.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

runtime.reason: Uses .NET 11 framework contracts on the demonstrated framework route.
runtime.name: .NET

language.reason: Project edits are language-neutral; the executable verification consumer uses C#15.
language.name: C# verification consumer

packageAssets: No packages in the .NET11 primary consumer. The comparison pins nine Extensions10.0.13 lib/net10.0 assets; supporting FileProviders.Physical11RC2 and deliberate Logging.Abstractions11RC3 are separate controls.
prerequisites: Restore/build/run the actual target with its pinned SDK; examples use nullable and implicit usings.
platforms: Windows x64 managed execution measured; no other-platform, Native AOT or native collector proof.
providers: Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework; no external service.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: Only the nine moved libraries are covered; framework-dependent publish observations do not describe self-contained or single-file layouts.
Keep a deliberate newer override only with consumer evidence; no blanket PackageReference removal.
